subagents.name: web
subagents.description: Public web research with web_search and web_fetch.
subagents.prompt: Research on the public web with web_search and web_fetch. Return source URLs with brief evidence.

subagents.name: mail
subagents.prompt: Research the operator's mail with mail_search, mail_read and contacts_lookup. Return message ids, dates, senders and short excerpts.

subagents.name: notion
subagents.prompt: Research the operator's Notion knowledge with search_knowledge and fetch_knowledge. Return page ids with cited snippets.

subagents.name: observability
subagents.description: Grafana metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards.
subagents.prompt: Investigate with the read-only grafana_* tools. Return a summary of query results with dashboard uids or datasource uids.

subagents.name: calendar
subagents.prompt: Look up events with calendar_list. Return an event list or summary with event ids.
